decision: Keep the ported PixelOS-AOSP tree at hardware/oplus. Penguin is not the best complete replacement for Porsche because required primary HAL implementations are absent.
pixel_reference_path_note: The original A17 reference was already promoted to hardware/oplus; hardware/oplus-a17-ref is not a second checkout. Upstream baseline ff49635 is retained in Git.
porsche_options: No A17 Porsche override; not enabled without verified device controls. TODO(porsche).
Preserve the primary A17 service defaults and selected VINTF fragments.
No verified Porsche glove-mode enable in the A17 reference. TODO(porsche).
Primary HAL defaults; Porsche DTS declares game_switch_support and black_gesture_indep_support.
Exact primary HAL default and kernel proc node.
These select the unused stock AIDL backend; direct mode uses game_switch_enable with 1/0.
Unchanged primary Porsche TouchscreenGestureConfig.h; no added gesture IDs.
Keep the primary direct proc-node backend, not an unverified stock AIDL server.
Explicit setting in the booting A17 Porsche device product.
Primary A17 uses module defaults; the uvite effect header has not been verified as an override for this implementation. TODO(porsche).
Primary hals.conf loads sensors.ssc.so and sensors.oplus.so. No verified FusionLight wrapper/backend. TODO(porsche).
conflicts: Penguin README advertises touch/livedisplay options whose implementations were removed in f90ff97.
Penguin lacks audio_amplifier.qcom, required by primary SM8350 common audio selection.
Penguin overlay namespace is overlay/, while the primary tree uses overlay/generic and overlay/qssi.
Penguin splits policy into common and qti hooks; replacing the tree would require translating existing verified CLO policy adaptations.
Unselected reference copies would duplicate module names without source exclusions; each reference is excluded.
validation: PASS: ARM/ARM64 display, selected Oplus HALs, UFS recovery, SELinux, integrated images and module dependency closure, VINTF with kernel requirements, and full signed OTA with metadata/firmware audit. Hardware boot remains untested.
